- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. h08.

Two types declare a `RunOnce` method — both are structs named `Runner`, in different runner packages:

1. **`s3presign.Runner`** (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — **invoked from production code.** Callers:
   - `(*Server).startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go:163` (a one-shot run at startup)
   - `(*Runner).Run` in the same package, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (invoked every 12 hours on a ticker; `Run` itself is started as a goroutine from `server/server.go:169`)

2. **`memopayload.Runner`** (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — **not invoked anywhere.** A repo-wide search finds no callers in production or test code. The `memopayload` package is used in production only via its standalone function `RebuildMemoPayload` (called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`), not through `Runner.RunOnce` — the runner type and its constructor `NewRunner` are effectively dead code.

Answer in the requested format:
- `s3presign.Runner` — invoked — `server/server.go:163` (and periodically via `s3presign.Runner.Run`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `memopayload.Runner` — not invoked — no caller
